worldcombat.skill.assist.summary: Call on nearby allies and borrow one of their learned moves to perform yourself; the borrowed move has limited reach and must be able to find a target, and it does not fire when nothing can be borrowed.
worldcombat.skill.assist.use.1: Borrow one ally move at random
worldcombat.skill.assist.description.0: After calling for %1$s it randomly borrows one move an ally inside the call radius has learned and performs it itself; it does not fire when no ally or no borrowable move answers.
worldcombat.skill.assist.description.1: The call radius is %1$s, and the borrowed move cannot reach farther than %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.assist.description.2: Current call radius setting: %1$s. Calling farther covers more allies but takes longer.
worldcombat.skill.assist.description.3: The borrowed move spends none of the ally's PP, only %1$s PP of the user's; calling again takes %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.assist.preference.call: Higher hears farther allies and widens the pool, but the shout takes longer; lower acts faster but may find nothing when alone or spread out.
worldcombat.skill.assist.description.fil: Not every move can be borrowed: some are excluded, and a borrowed move must also be able to reach a target; if no such move remains, the shout comes to nothing.
